title: Exactly one payload when issuing
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 2. Step 1 — Select the logical model for your use case; QR Code Generation, 4. Step 3 — Build the CWT claim set; HCERT Specification, 3.2.7 Health Certificate Claim.

statements.label: Exactly one payload when issuing
statements.requirement: The issuer SHALL emit an hcert (-260) map with exactly one entry. The verifier SHALL fail verification with MultipleSubclaims when there is more than one entry, and with HcertMissing when there is none.

sources.quote: An HCERT carries exactly one payload, identified by a subclaim inside the hcert claim
Map whose single key is the subclaim chosen in Step 1
Several different types of health certificate MAY exist under the same claim
